title: Standard protocols for immune profiling of peripheral blood leucocyte subsets by flow cytometry using DuraClone IM reagents
protocol: Dilute 100 µl IOTest 3 Fixative Solution (10X) with 900 µl PBS to obtain 0.8% IOTest 3 Fixative Solution.
Dilute 12.5 µl IOTest 3 Fixative Solution (10X) with 987.5 µl PBS to obtain 0.1% IOTest 3 Fixative Solution.
Prepare a 1/10 dilution of 10X Buffer 3 in ddH₂O: dilute 1 part 10X Buffer 3 with 9 parts of ddH₂O.
Collect peripheral blood samples directly into EDTA-vacutainers.
Store samples at 4 °C for a maximum of 4 h before processing.
Mix the blood sample by repeatedly inverting the vacutainer.
Transfer 100 µl blood into the DuraClone Tube for DuraClone IM Phenotyping Basic, T cell, TCRs and Granulocytes tube.
Transfer 200 µl blood into the DuraClone Tube for DuraClone IM Dendritic Cells tube.
Vortex tube for 8 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.
Add 2 ml VersaLyse Solution.
Vortex tube for 3 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Vortex tube for 3 seconds.
Add 3 ml DPBS.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Resuspend cell pellet in 380 µl 0.8 % IOTest 3 Fixative Solution for data collection using a Navios flow cytometer.
Collect peripheral blood samples directly into EDTA-vacutainers.
Mix the blood sample by repeatedly inverting the vacutainer.
Transfer 10 ml DPBS into a 15 ml conical bottom tube.
Add 300 µl blood to the 10 ml DPBS.
Mix by inverting the tube.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 300 g for 10 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Vortex tube for 3 seconds.
Add 10 ml DPBS.
Mix by inverting the tube.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 300 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Resuspend cell pellet in DPBS to get a final volume of 300 µl.
Transfer 100 µl of washed blood sample into the DuraClone IM B cells Tube.
Vortex tube for 8 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 min.
Add 2 ml VersaLyse.
Vortex for 3 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 min.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Vortex tube for 3 seconds.
Add 3 ml DPBS.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum a pump.
Resuspend cells in 380 µl 0.1 % IOTest 3 Fixative Solution for data collection using a Navios flow cytometer.
Mix the blood sample by repeatedly inverting the vacutainer.
Transfer 50 μl of blood into the DuraClone IM Treg Tube 1.
Vortex for 8 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.
Add 3 ml DPBS.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Vortex for 3 seconds.
Add 50 μl heat-inactivated FCS.
Mix by pipetting.
Add 5 μl PerFix-nc Buffer 1.
Vortex for 8 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.
Add 400 μl PerFix-nc Buffer 2.
Vortex for 8 seconds.
Transfer content of DuraClone IM Treg Tube 1 into DuraClone IM Treg Tube 2 by pipetting.
Vortex Tube 2 for 8 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 60 minutes.
Add 3 ml DPBS.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 5 minutes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Vortex for 3 seconds.
Add 3 ml of 1X PerFix-nc Buffer 3.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant using a vacuum pump.
Resuspend cells in 380 µl of 1X PerFix-nc Buffer 3 for data collection using a Navios flow cytometer.
